source_job_result: COMPLETED / 0:0; day30-to120 continuation, full diagnostic validation and exact restored checkpoint state
trajectory: Same v0.1.5 runtime continued from hour2 to48, then day2 to30, then day30 to120. Earlier diagnostics are inherited from exact-restored checkpoints; the first two hours predate the snow type correction.
display: Equirectangular maps; nearest saved native point on the sphere, without averaging field values. Inactive cells are grey; exactly zero ice is white and positive ice starts blue.
units: Ocean temperature in degrees Celsius; air temperature converted from K. Ice fraction and soil saturation multiplied by 100. Rain and snow water-equivalent rates multiplied by 86400 for mm/day.
precipitation_scale: Logarithmic; values below 0.01 mm/day share the lowest colour. Maps show instantaneous rain plus snow, not daily accumulation.

timelines.initial_missing: Initial unavailable radiation/air/rain/snow samples stay NaN and are not zero-filled.
timelines.extrema: Ocean extrema cover all wet depths. Ice maximum is area-equivalent thickness, not conditional thickness.

scope: 120-day initialized research baseline, not stationary climate or multi-year qualification. Radiation imbalance, ocean warming/freshening and coastal ice pile-up persist. No experimental land exchange change is included.
visual_review: Both exported PNGs inspected at native-aspect rendered size for six complete panels, readable units/titles/legends, correct masks, honest initial gaps and no visible clipping or overlap. No colour-vision simulation or narrow-browser check.
